subject: MedFlow evaluation kickoff — calendar options & success criteria
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medflow.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MedFlow evaluation kickoff — calendar options & success criteria

Hi Samir — thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. I wanted to capture the quick recap, propose next steps, and share a couple of calendar options for the evaluation kickoff (trial plan + prompt set/evals).

Recap (short):
- Goal: run a 4-week evaluation to validate LLM inference quality and cost at scale for MedFlow’s clinical summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria (what you called out): 1) average summarization ROUGE/clinical relevance meets your clinical QA thresholds, 2) end-to-end 95th pct latency < 250ms for 512-token requests at target concurrency, 3) predictable cost per 1k tokens within estimated band.
- Stakeholders to include: you (product), your ML lead, and your platform/infra lead for networking and VPC questions.

Proposed next step: a 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff where we:
- Walk through the trial plan and milestones (week-by-week),
- Align on the prompt set we’ll use for evals (I attached a prompt-set template),
- Confirm success criteria and how you’ll measure them,
- Review data security and network/access needs.

Available slots (PDT):
- Tue 19 May — 10:00–11:15
- Wed 20 May — 14:00–15:15
- Thu 21 May — 09:00–10:15

If none of those work, propose two windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. I attached a draft evaluation plan and the prompt-set template for your review. If there are other items you want on the kickoff agenda (e.g., SOC2 attachments, procurement timelines), call them out and we’ll include them.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0133
Redwood Inference

Ben — appreciate the clear recap. 15–30 minute follow-up from my team after today’s call landed the right way. We’re excited to move to a trial.

Quick notes:
- The ML lead (Aisha Khan) and our Platform lead (Rajiv Kumar — rajiv.k@medflow.ai) should be on the kickoff; I’ve looped Aisha here. Rajiv will be on travel next week but can dial in if needed.
- Security: we’ll send the preliminary security questionnaire back this afternoon — I’m attaching the doc we filled out for your records.
- Preferred kickoff: Wed 20 May 14:00–15:15 PDT works for us.

Agenda items to add:
- Confirmation of data handling for the prompt set (what leaves our VPC, what’s cached),
- Clear rollback/fallback plans if latency targets aren’t met during spike testing.

Thanks — please go ahead and lock the slot and share the invite.

—Samir

Thanks — looking forward.
Ben
